name: dynsight
description: Build-free C references, caller/callee graphs and a linked Context preview.
author: dylee

commands.title: Dynsight: Reanalyze Callback Candidates with Copilot

dynsight.copilotCallbacks.markdownDescription: Automatically request AI candidates for unresolved callbacks using your existing GitHub Copilot account. When enabled, startup, saved source changes and Rebuild analyze eligible calls one at a time and reuse valid cache. Calls must be in Copilot Include and Detailed Analysis Folders and outside exclusions. Choose a model when prompted; relevant source is sent to Copilot and account usage limits apply. Stop Copilot Analysis pauses automatic requests for this session and keeps completed results. [Analyze Callbacks with Copilot](command:dynsight.analyzeCallbacksWithCopilot), toggling this setting, or changing the model or scope resumes automatic analysis. Active User confirmed targets are skipped; use Recheck with AI for an individual comparison. AI candidates are suggestions, not proven calls.

dynsight.copilotModel.markdownDescription: Copilot model ID for callback candidates. [Select Copilot Model](command:dynsight.selectCopilotModel) lists models available to your Copilot account and saves the selected ID here. Selecting a model resumes automatic analysis when Copilot Callbacks is enabled; it does not enable the setting. An empty value asks you to choose when automatic analysis starts. Model changes reuse only that model's valid cache; unavailable models are not replaced automatically.

dynsight.copilotInclude.description: Files whose callback call sites may use AI, using workspace-relative globs. Only explicit paths are used; they are not copied from Include. Call locations must also be in Detailed Analysis Folders. Empty disables all AI callback requests. Copilot Exclude takes priority. Local analysis is unchanged and supporting evidence may come from other indexed paths. When Copilot Callbacks is enabled, scope changes cancel the active AI run and automatically analyze missing eligible results while reusing valid cache.

dynsight.copilotExclude.description: Workspace-relative glob patterns whose callback call sites skip AI, for example Vendor/** or Generated/**. Exclude takes priority over Copilot Include. Excluded sites use no AI requests and are omitted from AI results and pending counts; existing cached results are kept for later reuse. Local callback analysis and use as supporting source evidence remain available.

dynsight.analyzeCallbacks.deprecationMessage: Use Detailed Analysis Folders to scope macro expansion and callback propagation together. Explicit legacy settings remain active until that setting is saved.
dynsight.analyzeCallbacks.description: Infer function-pointer and structure callback targets in Callers, Callees and Callers & Callees, and trace callbacks when clicking their call sites. Turning off skips full callback propagation. Literal function assignments appear as Registration even without calls. Simple function-pointer and local structure-member assignments remain traceable, and available Copilot candidates remain selectable; unresolved sites use ordinary symbol navigation. Direct calls, macro expansion and literal function arguments remain available; alias-derived arguments require this option. Changes recalculate relationships without reparsing source files, after any running analysis finishes.

dynsight.includeFunctionArguments.description: Include functions passed as arguments in Callers, Callees and Callers & Callees. Dotted connectors mean argument passing, not proof of invocation. Changes reuse the existing index.

dynsight.callGraphDirection.description: Left/right branch placement in Callers & Callees mode. Changes presentation immediately without reindexing or resetting expanded branches.

enumDescriptions: Sort Callees by their first call location in source, not runtime execution order.
dynsight.calleeSort.description: Callees sorting. Open with the Relation Settings button. Callers and References keep name order.

enumDescriptions: Show Context and Relation together in the normal panel. Leaving an explicit alignment restores Center.
Use the full bottom width beneath both sidebars.
Keep the left sidebar full height; Combined uses the center and right bottom area.
Keep both sidebars full height; Combined uses the bottom area beneath the editor.
Keep the right sidebar full height; Combined uses the left and center bottom area.
Show Context as an independent Explorer view; drag its header to move it. Leaving an explicit alignment restores Center.
dynsight.contextLayout.description: Place Combined across the full bottom, preserve either sidebar's full height, or use only the center below the editor. Separate opens an independent Context view. Explicit alignment also changes Terminal and other bottom-panel views. All layouts share the same analysis and selection.

dynsight.include.description: Workspace-relative glob patterns to include in C/H analysis, for example App/** or Drivers/**. Empty includes all C/H files. Exclude always takes priority. Uses forward slashes. Changes reconcile selected files while reusing unchanged source analysis.

dynsight.exclude.description: Workspace-relative glob patterns excluded from indexing and file watching, for example **/Tools/Polyspace/**. Exclude takes priority over Include. Uses forward slashes. Changes reconcile selected files while reusing unchanged source analysis. Independent of files.exclude, search.exclude and C_Cpp.files.exclude.

dynsight.detailedAnalysisFolders.markdownDescription: [Select folders…](command:dynsight.selectDetailedAnalysisFolders) for macro expansion and callback propagation. Empty keeps basic navigation and explicit registrations only. Include/Exclude still control indexing; definitions from indexed headers remain available. External function bodies are not traced automatically. Changes refresh affected analysis and relationships. Legacy settings remain active until this setting is explicitly saved.

dynsight.macroExpansionFolders.deprecationMessage: Use Detailed Analysis Folders to scope macro expansion and callback propagation together. Explicit legacy settings remain active until that setting is saved.
dynsight.macroExpansionFolders.markdownDescription: [Select folders…](command:dynsight.selectMacroExpansionFolders) with checkboxes, or enter workspace-relative glob patterns such as `App/**`. Default `["**"]` expands all indexed sources; an empty list disables macro expansion. Unchecked sources keep basic analysis and header definitions remain available to checked sources. Include/Exclude still control which files are indexed. Changes refresh affected source analysis and relationships.

dynsight.skipInactive.description: Exclude provably inactive #if 0/1 branches. Unknown conditions remain visible.

dynsight.automaticUpdates.description: Check GitHub Releases daily and ask before installing a newer version.
